name: Glamping resort
summary: Safari tents, domes or yurts on raised platforms with power (and often water/ensuite bath), linked by paths to a central lodge/bathhouse. Per-unit cost swings mainly on whether units have ensuite plumbing and HVAC versus a shared bathhouse, and on the structure type (bell tent vs. safari tent vs. geodesic dome). No sourced glamping development budget could be retrieved in this session (web search budget exhausted); every value is a derived build-up from campground/RV infrastructure evidence and small-structure cost data. Confidence low.

typicalSize.method: Judgment: boutique glamping sites 6-15 units; branded resorts 30-100. Mid 20 (OH Weekly's illustrative premium-unit revenue model also uses 20 units, not retrieved as cost evidence).

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Interior floor area of the tent/dome/yurt (bell tent ~200 SF; safari tent 300-450 SF; large dome/yurt 500+ SF), excluding the open deck. Judgment.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Privacy spacing well below campground density (~9 sites/acre, campground file); judgment.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Central lot, one per unit plus staff; judgment.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Build-up for a mid-tier ensuite safari tent (~350 SF interior + ~150 SF deck): raised platform/deck ~$18k (~400 SF at ~$45/SF, judgment); tent structure delivered and erected ~$30k (judgment); ensuite bath pod and interior build-out ~$15k (judgment); per-unit power/water/sewer ~$9k (RV-site utilities $8.9k, rv e8); paths, landscaping, parking share ~$5k; share of lodge/bathhouse ~$10k (comfort station ~$0.7M, campground c2, spread over ~70 units, or a smaller lodge over 20). Total ~$87k -> $85k. Low $35k = bell tent on modest platform, power only, shared bathhouse. High $200k = luxury dome/safari suite with HVAC, hot tub and full ensuite, approaching small prefab cabin cost ($80-$230/SF, cabin b2). Not sourced; verify with tent/dome supplier quotes and a glamping feasibility study.

perSF.method: perPrimaryUnit / sfPerPrimaryUnit (35k/200, 85k/350, 200k/550), rounded. Includes per-unit site work and amenity share.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. general conditions and OH&P: platforms, tent/dome/yurt structures erected, ensuite plumbing where provided, per-unit utilities, paths, parking, landscaping and a share of the lodge/bathhouse. Excludes land, soft costs, FF&E/OS&E, off-site utilities, tap/impact fees and on-site wastewater treatment (line item).

systemSplit.method: Allocated from the mid build-up: tent/dome structure ($30k) -> 13 special construction (0.25 after lodge share); platform/deck and lodge framing -> 06 (0.18); ensuite plumbing -> 22; per-unit utilities -> 26/33; paths/parking/landscape -> 32; lodge share spread over 03/07/09/23; general conditions 7%.

lineItems.name: Safari tent / geodesic dome / yurt structure, delivered and erected

cost.method: Judgment: canvas bell tent (low) to engineered safari tent or insulated dome with windows (high). No supplier pricing retrieved; verify.

lineItems.notes: Carve-out. Canvas replacement cycle 5-10 years is an operating/capex item.

lineItems.name: Raised timber platform and deck

cost.method: Judgment: pressure-treated platform on piers (low) to composite deck with railings and stairs (high).

lineItems.notes: Carve-out; qty = SF of platform per unit.

lineItems.name: Ensuite bathroom (pod or framed), water heater and fixtures
lineItems.notes: Remove (and enable shared-bathhouse) for economy tier.

lineItems.name: Per-unit utility runs (power, water, sewer lateral)

cost.method: RV-site sewer $2.5k + water $2.4k + electrical $4.0k = $8.9k (rv e8/e9); low = power only.

lineItems.name: Central lodge / check-in / guest lounge
lineItems.notes: Carve-out of the amenity share; resorts with food service need a commercial kitchen (add).

lineItems.name: Shared bathhouse (units without ensuite baths)

cost.method: Public comfort station comparables: SD $705,540 (2023, campground c2); OR prototype $1.1M (2024, campground c3); low = smaller private building.

lineItems.notes: Switch on for economy tier (and remove ensuite pods).

cost.method: Same as cabin-str-resort hot tub line (judgment).
Scaled from RV park evidence (small park entire septic ~$100k, rv e14); judgment.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Judgment: bed, linens, furniture, wood stove/heater or mini-split, outdoor furniture, fire pit; high for luxury suites.

pctOfHard.method: Judgment: site civil and septic design, land-use approval (often conditional use for campground/resort), structural review of tents/platforms; mid 15%.

design.method: Judgment; code treatment of tents (temporary vs. permanent structure) varies by jurisdiction.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Min = bell tent + shared bathhouse with low soft; max = luxury dome suite with hot tub and lodge share plus soft costs.

openQuestions: No sourced glamping development budget was retrieved (web search budget exhausted mid-session). Priority sources: public feasibility study summaries (e.g., state park glamping concession RFPs), tent/dome manufacturer price lists, Glamping Business / Hipcamp host cost guides, USDA B&I or SBA loan feasibility for glamping.
